description: This file defines the InvalidParamException class used for handling specific parameter validation errors within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the base Exception class and adds functionality to manage an error bag.

classes.name: InvalidParamException
classes.description: Custom exception class for invalid parameter errors, providing additional context through an error bag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with an optional error bag and message.

methods.name: getErrorBag
methods.description: Returns the error bag containing invalid parameters.

methods.name: setErrorBag
methods.description: Sets the error bag with invalid parameters.

methods.name: getNormalizedErrorBag
methods.description: Returns a normalized array with invalid parameter keys.
